title: tailwind-merge misses the conflict when a class has an important modifier and a postfix modifier
body: Bug (frontend class-name component, package packages/tailwind-merge): twMerge('!text-lg/7 !text-sm') returns both classes although both set font-size as important; the same class without the leading '!' or with a trailing 'text-lg/7!' merges correctly.

Outcome: a leading important modifier does not shift the postfix modifier position, so '!text-lg/7 !text-sm' gives '!text-sm', '!text-lg/7 !text-lg/9' gives '!text-lg/9' and '!text-lg/7 !text-sm/6' gives '!text-sm/6'; existing behaviour is unchanged. Fix packages/tailwind-merge/src/lib/parse-class-name.ts and add tests in packages/tailwind-merge/tests/important-modifier.test.ts.

acceptance.verify: mise exec pnpm@12.5.1 -- pnpm exec vitest --no-watch packages/tailwind-merge/tests/important-modifier.test.ts
